title: Experimental festival: Public page
creator: NotorismDesign
description: A simplified original composition study, not a historical specimen or a real-client website screenshot.

analysis.hierarchy: A subject-specific headline, one action, then related collections.
analysis.composition: A public opening with a focal visual and supporting content.
analysis.treatment: Intentional asymmetry; scale reversals; graphic cuts; unexpected composition with recognizable routes.
analysis.transfer: Transfer relationships and material mechanics; replace all fictional content with the actual brief.
analysis.limitation: Making reading, purchasing, and navigation into puzzles.
